### 🔒 Closed-Source Repository Notice

Thank you for your interest in **Vzon Launcher**!

> **Notice:** Vzon Launcher is developed as a **closed-source, proprietary application** by [xdNOT Labs](https://github.com/SeNsXD). As such, we **cannot accept code pull requests** or merge external code modifications into this repository.

### How You Can Contribute & Get Involved

Even though the underlying codebase is private, your feedback and input drive Vzon's development:

- 🐛 **Report Bugs:** Open an issue via our [Bug Report Form](https://github.com/SeNsXD/Vzon-Launcher/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml).
- 💡 **Suggest Features:** Submit new card concepts or workflow improvements via our [Feature Request Form](https://github.com/SeNsXD/Vzon-Launcher/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml).
- 💬 **Join Discussions:** Share your home screen layouts, icon pairings, and design critiques in [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/SeNsXD/Vzon-Launcher/discussions).
- 🌐 **Translations & Localization:** If you would like to help translate Vzon Launcher into your language, please open an issue with the `translation` label!
